risks.title: Context Attention Saturation (T=128 tokens)
risks.details: Multi-turn dialogue and document RAG fail beyond 128 tokens. Requires WS07 Stage C E4 scaling to T=512.

risks.title: Capacity Bottleneck (528k params)
risks.details: Under-parameterized model failing 23/24 capability probes. Requires WS07 Stage C E5 scaling to ~3.2M params.

risks.title: Greedy Repetition Loops in Raw Weights
risks.details: theta=1.25 + no_repeat_ngram_size=3 drops 3-gram repetition to 0.0000. Must be wired into InferenceRuntimeService.

risks.title: Synthetic Data Domination
risks.details: Enforced 8:1 synthetic volume cap and mandatory human review queue in dataset_expansion_validator.py

risks.title: Admin Role Stored in Env Config
risks.details: Fails closed to AdminRole.ADMIN; high-risk proposals enforce two-person verification drill.

risks.title: Host CPU Starvation During Training
risks.details: torch.set_num_threads(2) and 2GB RAM hard ceiling enforced. Peak observed: 479.27 MB.

risks.title: Heuristic N-gram Embedding Inaccuracy
risks.details: Character n-gram hashing trick cannot resolve conceptual paraphrases. Roadmap P2: integrate trained bi-encoder.

risks.title: No Docker Containerization
risks.details: Zero Dockerfile/docker-compose.yml in repo. Manual environment setup required. Roadmap P2.

risks.title: 53 Duplicate Class Names Across Runners
risks.details: BrudSmallV2Model in 4 runner scripts, CreateSessionRequest across 12 Mini Brain models. No runtime conflict.
